RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN MEDIA (PRIVATE) LIMITED
(“COMPANY”) PASSED ON THE 13th DAY OF APRIL 2021
Agenda
The Board was informed that pursuant to the Company’s resolution dated 15 March 2021 with
respect to obtaining Alfalah Fleet Finance from Bank Alfalah Limited (“Bank”) for which Mr.
Zeeshan Ali Khan and Mr. Imran Ali Khan, Directors of the Company, provided personal
guarantees to the Bank, the Company intends to indemnify Mr. Zeeshan Ali Khan and Mr.
Imran Ali Khan by way of issuance of indemnity bond(s).
The Board unanimously nominated Mr. Imran Ali Khan and Mr. Zeeshan Ali Khan to discuss,
negotiate and accept this proposal.
Resolutions
After discussing the aforesaid matter
passed/approved/adapted by the Board:

in detail,

the following

resolutions were

1) Resolved that, the Company be and is hereby authorized to indemnify Mr. Imran Ali Khan
and Mr. Zeeshan Ali Khan by way of issuance of indemnity bond(s).
2) Resolved further that, Mr. Imran Ali Khan and Mr. Zeeshan Ali Khan be and are hereby
authorized, directed and empowered to sign, present, declare, submit and file, for and on
behalf of the Company, the indemnity bond(s) and to do or cause to be done all such acts,
deeds or things as may be required and necessary in this regard from time to time.
